# lmw post comment

Comment on a post (asks for confirmation)

### Synopsis

Comment on a post, after showing the comment and asking you to type 'comment'.

LinkedIn sometimes reports an error after the comment was posted, so lmw never
retries: check the post before trying again.

```
lmw post comment POST [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw post comment urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678 --text "Great write-up, thanks!"
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help               help for comment
      --text string        comment text
      --text-file string   file with the comment text
```
